question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'Tabaqat-i-Nasiri'?
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Minhaj-us-Siraj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tabaqat-e-Nasiri -​**

 
 
• **The author of this book is Minhaj-us-Siraj__**.
 
• In this book information about the** conquest of India of Mohammad Ghori **and the early history of the Turkish Sultanate is found till about 1260 AD.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Zia-ud-din Barani-**

 
 
• He lived in the times of Muhammad bin Tughlaq and Firoz Shah.
 
• His famous book is'Tarikh Forozshahi'.
 
 
 
• **Amir Khusrau -**
 
 
• He was the **first Muslim poet** and played an important role in the** invention of 'Khari Boli'.**
 
• He saw the rule of 7 sultans (Balban, Muhammad, Kaiqubad, Jalaluddin Khilji, Alauddin Khilji, Mubarak Shah Khilji, Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq).​​ ​
 
 
 
• **Al Beruni -**
 
 
• He was a** Persian scholar, writer, scientist, **theologian, and thinker.
 
• He was with the Sultan in many campaigns of Mahmud of Ghazni (who attacked India several times).
 
• Alberuni was said to be** the first scholar of Indian history.**
